_note: This is a VALIDATION SPEC, not exact expected output. Model output varies - the runner validates structure + semantic coverage, not exact text.

schema.improvements: array of 1-3 strings, imperative format, generalized (no file paths)
schema.rules: array of 0-5 strings, format 'Context: Rule', generalized (no file paths/names/URLs)

must_detect.description: Bash with PowerShell cmdlets on what appears to be a Linux system (or vice versa after compaction)
must_detect.min_coverage: At least 1 improvement or rule mentioning shell/OS mismatch or verifying environment before commands

must_detect.description: Glob called 3 times - same intent, first 3 returned empty
must_detect.min_coverage: At least 1 improvement or rule mentioning retry limits, re-scoping searches, or switching tools after repeated failures

must_detect.description: Input tokens climb from 4.5K to 12K to 28K to 35K to 41K+ across successive turns
must_detect.min_coverage: At least 1 improvement or rule mentioning token/context management, compacting, or budget awareness

must_detect.description: Compaction at 54K to 15K, then agent uses Bash 'ls' and 'cat' despite being on Windows
must_detect.min_coverage: At least 1 improvement or rule about rechecking environment/OS after compaction

must_detect.description: Config file modified 4 separate times for what could have been 1-2 edits
must_detect.min_coverage: At least 1 improvement about batching edits or minimizing tool calls

must_not_detect.description: No false positives - should not report issues that aren't seeded

rules_must_NOT_contain: Specific error messages (like 'Get-ChildItem: command not found')
anti_patterns.quality_score_range: expect 0.25-0.60 - low because of multiple errors + retries + bloat + overengineering, but not extremely low because task completed and test passed
